## Conventions

- [ ] Commit message follows `type: summary` (`feat` / `fix` / `docs` / `refactor` / `test` / `style` / `chore`)
- [ ] The detailed version of anything is written in **exactly one place**; other places link to it
- [ ] Root-level docs stay repository-level (they do not restate project implementation details)
- [ ] Assets: **one copy, English only**, no language suffix
- [ ] Checked which license applies to what I changed (root / quickstart / voice-module = MIT;
      `pipecat-open-webui/` = upstream Open WebUI License + MIT for new files)
